rules.R-DECLINED: no action toward a person who declined contact
rules.R-NOT-READ: no comment on a post not read in full with its replies
rules.R-RELATION: no invitation to an existing first-degree relation
rules.R-ROLE-UNCONFIRMED: no invitation while the person's current role is not confirmed: wait

recheck: the enforcement point rechecks the approval or the bounds before each attempt, on its own clock
